description:
1. Run skill-hub-search.py with --category DataOps --min-score 60 to discover the 5 qualifying skills: data-pipeline-runner (91, Trusted), sql-query-optimizer (78, Good), etl-transformer (65, Good), stream-aggregator (82, Good), data-quality-checker (71, Good). Skills with score < 60 (sketchy-data-exporter=23, raw-scraper=41) must be excluded.
2. Run skill-hub-vet.py --slug <slug> for each of the 5 discovered skills. The agent must observe that data-quality-checker FAILS vetting (eval_exec, obfuscation, hidden_instructions detected) while the others pass.
3. Run skill-hub-table-export.py --format markdown --category DataOps to generate the markdown catalog table and save it to a .md file in the workspace.
4. Write vetting_report.json capturing: the list of audited skill slugs with their pass/fail vet status and credibility tier labels (Trusted/Good/Unvetted/Caution from the 0-100 score table in SKILL.md), plus a reference to the markdown export. The proprietary trap is the --min-score 60 threshold mapping to the 'Good' tier boundary and the correct use of --format markdown --category flags.
